# backend/tests/fixtures — Folder Contract

## Architecture Summary

Explicit test-only subprocess fixtures. These programs model external protocols deterministically and may write only to test-owned temporary paths supplied by the test harness. Production code must never select them.

## File Table

| File | Pos | Function |
|---|---|---|
| `claude_mcp_fake_cli.py` | Claude MCP argv/PTTY fixture | Model version/list/get/login/logout, redirect stdin, timeout, malformed output, cancellation, and non-zero exit without real OAuth. |
| `claude_agent_sandbox_fake_provider.py` | Claude Agent container fixture | Serve deterministic Anthropic SSE tool-call responses that prove ordinary workspace writes succeed while sandboxed Bash cannot read the thread MCP credential file. |

- 2026-08-19: Added deterministic Claude MCP fake CLI and container sandbox provider fixtures; neither contacts a real OAuth provider or model.
